events.headline: INCIDENT
events.description: Johnston Bridge, in both directions. Travel advisory in effect at Front St. In Quesnel. Bridge is closed. Industrial traffic and heavy commercial traffic must detour via Plywood Rd and Maple Drive. Industrial traffic is not allowed to detour through Johnston Subdivision. Next update time Mon Oct 19 at 9:00 AM PDT. Last updated Wed Jun 3 at 2:14 PM PDT. (DBC-47311)

events.headline: CONSTRUCTION

Speed Limit restriction: 50 kmh. Bus on Shoulder project. No impact during day. Periodic night work with 5min stoppages. I. events.headline: CONSTRUCTION
events.description: Highway 5, southbound. Construction work between Miledge Creek Bridge and Thunder River Rd for 4.9 km (17 to 12 km north of Blue River). Until Sat Nov 7 at 5:00 PM PST. From 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST on weekdays. Watch for traffic control. Single Lane Alternating Traffic will only be required for a brief duration during mobilization and demobilization of materials and equipment. Last updated Mon Jan 26 at 10:10 AM PST. (DBC-82106)

events.headline: CONSTRUCTION
events.description: Highway 97 (Alaska Highway). Bridge construction between Sikanni Chief Rd and Prophet River Sub Rd (94 km south of Fort Nelson). Until Sat Oct 31. Single lane alternating traffic. Bridge construction at the Bougie Bridge south of Prophet River. Width restriction to 3.8 meters, Height restriction to 5.33 meters, Length restriction to 27.5m. GVW 81,500 kg. Last updated Mon Jun 1 at 7:17 AM MST. (DBC-92059)
